_meta: A cohort of patients used to show immortal time bias: classifying subjects as 'treated' when treatment can only start after some time means the treated group had to SURVIVE to that time, so a guaranteed-alive stretch gets credited to the treatment and inflates its apparent benefit -- even when the treatment does nothing. Many observational studies compare a group that received an intervention against one that did not, where the intervention is delivered at some point after enrollment: a transplant that becomes available, a medication a patient survives long enough to fill, an award given years into a career. To be classified in the treated group at all, a subject must survive until the intervention -- a subject who dies before then is, by construction, in the untreated group. That pre-treatment survival is 'immortal time': a period during which a treated subject could not have died without leaving the treated group. Analyzing survival from enrollment (time 0) and classifying by whether treatment was ever received credits the treated group with this immortal, death-free time and simultaneously dumps all the early deaths into the untreated group, so the treated group looks better regardless of any real effect. The fix is a landmark analysis: pick the time by which treatment status is determined, keep only subjects still alive at that landmark, classify them by their status AT the landmark, and measure survival FROM the landmark -- so the immortal time is excluded and both groups are compared over time in which either could die. landmark is the day treatment status is assessed; groups gives each cohort's death days: 'early' died before the landmark (never treated), 'treated' survived to the landmark and were treated, 'untreated_survivors' survived to the landmark and were not treated. The death days are set so post-landmark survival is identical for treated and untreated survivors -- the treatment truly has no effect. landmark and groups are the fixture; the naive ever-treated survival difference and the landmark survival difference are computed.
